objective: Find useful, reproducible inference-time control mechanisms in frozen JEPA-WM for Reach-Wall and Push-T; informative failures are valid outcomes.
authorization: User requested four parallel diagnostics, broad evolutionary/greedy search including heads, dimensions, subspaces and interactions, then invoked autoresearch.
primary_utility: Actual simulator task outcomes versus the same frozen unsteered model/planner; short action forks are exploratory proxies, not full-episode success claims.
first_checkpoint: Four diagnostics plus up to three broad search generations, with measured compute accounting; do not stop after the first negative or positive result.
resources: Existing explicitly project-leased usable instances only, no additional rentals, one independent workload per GPU.
search_episodes: Reach-Wall development0..7; Push distinct TRAIN initial-state groups with separate development-validation groups.
development_validation: Reach8..11 and previously seen Push development panels are not untouched confirmation.
confirmation: Original held Reach12..23 and reserved Push evaluation panels stay unopened until candidate, endpoint, comparator, sample size and analysis are frozen; do not reuse confirmation for search.
selection: Keep every trial, failure and null result; forecast-error and sham-specificity rank candidates but do not prove behavioral utility; equal-start aggregation.
breadth: Cover all implemented head/block sites, preserve diverse families and fresh mutations/restarts; report actual tested coverage, not the hypothetical Cartesian search space.
dose: Cap base edits in post-projection/action-gate residual norm, then apply dose; paired interaction components share one total budget.

literature_updates.use: Motivates native CEM restart control for optimizer variability; does not establish our compensation explanation.
Motivates coarse versus near-selected action ranking; different LeWM training study, no weights changed here.
Related frozen-world-model objective/optimizer intervention; terminal readout validity and component interactions require testing, not assumed transfer.
